review.note: Release 0.2.0: rechecked PyPI/npm latest candidates and reviewed official release notes: https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/ (1.32.4 fixes plugin typing regression; no custom hooks), https://build.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html (1.6.1 Windows symlink regression fix), https://packaging.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html (26.3 retains required Version/Requirement/SpecifierSet APIs; Python 3.14 satisfies support), https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html (2.4.0 native parser changes validated by strict checking), https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html (9.1.1 parametrization/conftest fixes), https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.0 (explicit py314 target and selected rules avoid default-policy drift), https://github.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/blob/v0.23.3/CHANGELOG.md (dependency refresh; Node 26.10.0). All latest versions satisfy current open lower bounds; no new upper bound or exact-pin exception. With Python 3.14.1 and these installed versions: 262 tests passed; Ruff, strict mypy 42 source files and local Markdown checks passed. Fresh sdist-derived 0.2.0 wheel and all component resources verified offline. A separate clean uv environment normally resolved the explicit candidate wheel plus packaging 26.3; installed package/metadata origin and every wheel member except rewritten RECORD were byte-verified. Six consumer bundles regenerated from that installed candidate. Windows-native workflow remains separate and was not executed on this macOS host.
